answer: A walnut opens only when three unrelated pulses sign it once each and burn a relic into the shell; a relic burns once, so one pulse signs one walnut ever, and the pulse registry is fixed and finite, so no fake pulse can be conjured. Honest walnuts draw their own pulses, paid from what they earn; a fake earns nothing, so each of its three signatures must be bribed in coin it never earns back. One relic, one signature, no bill splits: the thousandth fake bribes three pulses the honest crowd already refused, at premiums its first clone never met, while the honest newcomer beside it walks in free.
